newsitem.title: USA: Abbott to buy parts of Sanofi business.
newsitem.headline: Abbott to buy parts of Sanofi business.

text.p: Abbott Laboratories said it signed a definitive agreement to acquire for about $200 million certain parenteral products businesses from Sanofi Pharmaceuticals Inc, the U.S. unit of France's Sanofi.
The parenteral businesses make intravenous products, including Sanofi's proprietary Carpuject pre-filled, single-dose syringe technology, to which Abbott will gain worldwide rights.

Abbott said it will also obtain a range of multi-source injectable drugs and other products, as well as a production and research and development plant in McPherson, Kansas. No changes are planned at the plant, the company said.
"With this acquisition, Abbott will be able to provide a more complete line of injectable products," said Abbott president Thomas Hodgson in a statement.
The transaction is entirely in cash, Abbott said.
